hints: The whole tree is one extra line inside Dijkstra: when dist[u] + w[u][v] beats dist[v], also set parent[v] = u.
Write each tree edge in ONE direction only, parent -> child: tree[parent[v]][v]. The official sample's matrix is not symmetric even though its roads are.
Leaves = vertices other than s that are nobody's parent. Count children with children[parent[v]]++. Do not count s: in the official sample the depot has a single child and the answer is still 1.
source: NITC_Lab_S3_DSA Week 4 - SSSP/MQ4.pdf (official statement; test 1 is the official sample)
